Equitable Excellence Scholarship®

The Equitable Excellence Scholarship® program is the flagship program of Equitable Foundation, the company’s charitable-giving arm. The enhanced scholarship program includes renewable scholarships for high school seniors and engagement to create pathways to leadership and development opportunities for aspiring college students.

 

The Equitable Excellence Scholarship® program supports students from across the country who strive to be a force for good in their communities. By pursuing a postsecondary degree, these students show fortitude and resilience, and plan to inspire others in their community to pursue higher education.

In alignment with Equitable’s own mission of helping people achieve financial security so that they can face the future with confidence, the Equitable Excellence Scholarship® program places an emphasis on empowering students’ future plans so that they can continue to have positive impacts in their community. We are thrilled to share that our 2027 Equitable Excellence Scholarship® application is now open and will be active through Tuesday, December 22nd, 2026. 

This year our scholarship recipients will receive a $5,000 renewable scholarship for up to four years of their undergraduate study, for a total of $20,000 in financial support. Scholarship recipients  also receive special access to workshops centered around financial wellness, mental wellness and critical professional leadership and development sessions tailored to support resume building and personal branding. 

Each year, the scholarship program aspires to reach students in need, with  70% of last year’s recipients being first-generation college students. Our 2026 scholarship winners hail from 19 states, representing 70 different high schools. Since the program’s inception, Equitable has awarded $30 million in scholarships to 7,500 students. Equitable Foundation manages the delivery of the awards program in partnership with Scholarship America, a national nonprofit dedicated to administering scholarship opportunities.

As the largest 403(b) provider for educators across the country, we believe it’s important to our mission that we help support the educators that are empowering today’s students. To make an even bigger impact directly to educators, we ask each recipient to identify a teacher who made a significant difference in his or her academic journey. To express our gratitude, Equitable will provide a $500 gift card to each educator for classroom supplies or professional development. 

The Equitable Excellence Scholarship®  program is supported through strategic partnerships between Equitable and Scholarship America that includes, CommonApp, National College Attainment Network (NCAN)  and other college access community-based organizations across the country that assist students who apply for scholarships and are seeking resources to support the college application process.

Eligibility

We’re committed to students who show potential. Those with the courage to pursue what’s possible; display strength in managing challenges; share wisdom with others. The Equitable Excellence Scholarship® is our promise to those individuals dedicated to achieving their dreams. 

  • Be a current public high school senior that resides in one of the 50 U.S. states, District of Columbia or Puerto Rico, who plans to enroll full-time in an accredited two- or four-year college or university in the United States for the entire upcoming academic year.
  • Demonstrate ambition and self-drive to be a force for good in their communities by encouraging others to pursue higher education.
  • Be willing to provide a release to publicize their identities and information about their plans or achievements along with photographs for use in Program promotion/information.
  • Have a minimum grade point average of 2.5 on a 4.0 scale (or its equivalent, weighted or unweighted).
  • Applicants must show financial need.

To learn more and apply for the Equitable Excellence Scholarship®, visit

https://scholarshipamerica.org/scholarship/equitableexcellence/
